value.rationale: The recently defined parent expansion naturally contains an earlier pointed inverse semigroup with a different identity, creating a motivated isomorphism-reconstruction and symmetry comparison problem. The theorem settles it completely across all finite groups, including nonabelian groups, and establishes the exact \(|G|\)-index symmetry breaking, the orbit of all pointed copies and faithful inner action. These are structural explanations of how the unit-group action enlarges symmetries, rather than an isolated finite count.
